recommended_approach: Use Mantaflow via the Fluid modifier by configuring a GAS Domain (accessible through `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings`) and one or more Flow objects (configured through `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings`). For detail on a small-scale flame, rely on the domain’s noise controls (e.g., `FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength`, `FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim`) and tune the flow’s emission mode using `FluidFlowSettings.flow_type`, `FluidFlowSettings.flow_source`, and `FluidFlowSettings.flow_behavior`.

domain.cell_size: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.cell_size) — small cell size implied for macro flame detail
domain.noise_strength: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength) — use for small-scale turbulent detail
domain.noise_time_anim: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim) — animate noise over time for slow, graceful variation
domain.flip_ratio: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio) — listed attribute; generally keep stable unless intentionally mixing solver behavior
domain.fluid_group: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.fluid_group) — use to manage which objects participate as fluid/flow objects

flow.flow_type: (property exists: FluidFlowSettings.flow_type) — set flow to the appropriate emission type for a fire/smoke source
flow.flow_source: (property exists: FluidFlowSettings.flow_source) — choose the source basis (e.g., geometry/texture-driven) as needed for a wick-sized emitter
flow.flow_behavior: (property exists: FluidFlowSettings.flow_behavior) — controls how emission behaves over time (e.g., continuous vs. other behaviors)
flow.noise_texture: (property exists: FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture) — can be used to modulate emission

render_shading_hooks.color_grid: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.color_grid) — available for grid-based coloration workflows
render_shading_hooks.color_ramp: (property exists: FluidDomainSettings.color_ramp) — available for ramp-based coloration workflows
